# ToolMaster Pro

> 100+ Free Online Tools for Professionals, Developers, and Students. No signup required, privacy-first, and browser-based.

## Core Categories

- AI & Content: Blog writers, rephrasers, hashtag generators.
- Image Tools: Background remover, compressors, resizers, editors.
- PDF Tools: Merger, splitter, compressor, text extractor.
- Developer Tools: JSON formatter, Base64, UUID, SQL formatters.
- SEO & Marketing: Meta tag generators, keyword density, sitemap tools.
- Calculators: BMI, Currency, Loan, Percentage, TDEE.
- Text Tools: Word counter, Case converter, Diff checker.
- Media: Video trimmer, GIF maker, Video to GIF.

## Privacy & Security

Every tool runs locally in the user's browser using technologies like WASM, ffmpeg.wasm, and Transformers.js. Data is never uploaded to a server, ensuring 100% privacy and lightning-fast speed.
